title: ItipMechanism
description: ITIP base Archetype for Mechanism — causal behavioral logic inside a Structure. Inherits gsm/Mechanism through the top-level $ref and composes the ITIP-wide ItipAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Mechanism statement distributed in an ITIP framework MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Mechanism, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: ITIP (framework foundation).
